# ADR-3104: A09: Clock skew ignore for audit stamp 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Skew breaks correlation across systems.

## Decision

Auditors SHALL NOT accept a clock skew ignore for audit stamp 8 (A09-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

NTP hardening is mandatory.
